subject: [PATCH v4 03/14] SUNRPC: keep the first error in svc_register()

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch modifies the svc_register() function in the SUNRPC module to keep track of the first error encountered during RPC program registration, rather than overwriting it with subsequent errors. This ensures that an earlier failure is not erased by a later success or failure. The fix addresses a problem introduced by a previous patch that allowed further customization of RPC program registration.
